annual_endpoint_policy: At least eight storage months; incomplete calendar endpoint years excluded
human_TWS_validation: Well heads assess only groundwater consistency and cannot directly validate full human TWSA
human_GWS_validation: Climate-controlled, detrended and contiguous-change associations supplement raw agreement; no storage coefficient or causal pumping proof
reference_period: Human-model difference represents change relative to 2004–2009, not cumulative pre-GRACE depletion
